column2: Hits may chill enemies. Freezing an enemy deals bonus damage. Attack vs chilled/frozen enemies +3%/Lv. Also lengthens freeze time and strengthens the slow on bosses
At HP 50% or less, attack speed +3%/Lv. At HP 25% or less, the bonus doubles (+6%/Lv)
Landing a hit in midair triggers a follow-up area slash at the hit point. Power and area rise with Lv
Air attack +3%/Lv. Each hit landed without touching the ground adds +1%/Lv more (up to 4 times). Landing resets the extra
Attack vs airborne enemies up (+8%/Lv) (launched or flying mobs; among bosses, only the dragon and the demon)
Attack range +3%/Lv. Melee attacks cover a wider area and projectiles fly farther (projectile size unchanged)
At HP 50% or less, attack +5%/Lv and attack speed +2%/Lv. At HP 25% or less, both bonuses double
Attack +6%/Lv, attack speed +1%/Lv. But seals max HP hearts (1 at Lv1–3, 2 at Lv4–6, 3 at Lv7–9)
At HP 50% or less, attack +4%/Lv. At HP 25% or less, the chance to drain (heal 1 heart) on enemy/boss kills is also +3%/Lv
At regular boss gates, a chance (8%/Lv) for one more boss to join. Boss MILE +50%/Lv. Doesn't apply to the dedicated bosses every 10km or the Last Dungeon boss rush
Attack +7%/Lv. But each front/back attack lowers move speed by 10% for 0.4s
Burn power +8%/Lv, burn duration +0.25s/Lv. This card alone can also burn on hit (chance 7% at Lv1, then +2%/Lv)
Defeating an enemy causes an explosion around it. Enemies killed by the blast chain further, up to 3 stages. Each enemy is hit at most once per chain

Activates at 100% Gauge (bottom-left button). Your character's signature move defeats regular on-screen enemies in one hit and deals 20–40% of max HP to bosses (rises with Lv). Then you surge far ahead (Lv1 300m → Lv9 1000m; stops before boss gates etc., no surge during boss fights) and a buff lasts a while (Lv1 5s → Lv9 12s). Gauge fills with distance, kills and boss damage
When the finisher of an attack string hits, an extra shockwave bursts forward (power and area rise with Lv)
Attack of the last hit (finisher) when chaining front/back attacks +7%/Lv
Blocking an attack with a Shield releases a counter shockwave around you. Power rises with Lv. This card alone also lets you hold 1 Shield
Attack +12%/Lv. But seals max HP hearts (1 at Lv1–2, +1 more every 2 Lv after; 5 at Lv9)
Some mobs become elites (+4% per Lv; HP ×2.5, a bit faster; kills give MILE ×3/EXP ×2). MILE also up (+30%/Lv)
MILE from defeating enemies +15%/Lv. Also applies to BONUS ZONE and WANTED reward MILE
EXP gained down (-10%/Lv, never below 25% of normal); in exchange, kill & BONUS MILE +30%/Lv
EXP from enemy kills, boss kills and BONUS ZONE greatly up (+80%/Lv). Distance EXP not included
Hits have a chance to burn enemies, dealing damage for 3s. Lv1: 15% chance, 5 damage/s; each Lv after: chance +5%, damage/s +1.5
Blocking an attack with a Shield releases a flame counter around you that burns enemies hit. Power rises with Lv. This card alone also lets you hold 1 Shield
Hits chill enemies and slow them. Lv1: 15% chance, 25% slow; each Lv after: chance +5%, slow +2%. 5 stacked chills freeze (bosses slow down instead of stopping)
Hits may release a wind blade. Wind blade speed +5%/Lv, range +0.4m/Lv. Wind blades and projectiles pierce +1 (+2 from Lv4, +3 from Lv7)
Slam landings or a grounded finisher send a shockwave along the ground (power and length rise with Lv). Ground attack also +2%/Lv
Attack +4%/Lv, plus +0.6%/Lv more attack per sealed heart (seals from other cards count too). Also seals max HP hearts itself (1 at Lv1–3, 2 at Lv4–6, 3 at Lv7–9)
Max HP +1 heart/Lv (up to 20 hearts). Fully restores HP when taken
Damage of 2+ hearts is reduced by 1 heart. Max HP also up (+1 heart at Lv1–2, then +1 every 2 Lv). Jump power -3%/Lv
Down attack and slam landing attack +10%/Lv. Finisher also +3%/Lv
Mob HP +12%/Lv, action speed +4%/Lv, enemy encounter rate +8%/Lv. In exchange, kill & BONUS MILE +50%/Lv, boss MILE +30%/Lv
Enemy encounter rate +15%/Lv. In exchange, kill & BONUS MILE +5%/Lv, kill & BONUS EXP +5%/Lv
During boss fights, attack step distance (forward/back) +4%/Lv. Move speed when closing in on a boss more than 6m away also +3%/Lv
Hits may chill. Fewer chills needed to freeze (4 at Lv1–3, 3 at Lv4–6, 2 at Lv7–9). Chill chance and duration also up
Defeating a burning enemy spreads fire around it, burning enemies (power and area rise with Lv). This card alone also has a low chance (5%) to burn on hit
Air jumps +1/Lv. Stacked extra jumps rise less, but not while falling into a pit. Sorceress: reachable height +1 tier at Lv1–3, +2 at Lv4–6, +3 at Lv7–9

The moment damage drops HP to 1 heart or less, gain brief invincibility (1s +0.15s/Lv). Doesn't prevent fall damage. Triggers again only once HP is back above 1 heart and 20s have passed since activation
EXP gained +30%/Lv
Attack range +5%/Lv. Melee attacks cover a wider area and projectiles fly farther
EXP gained +15%/Lv. Max HP also up (+1 heart at Lv1–3, +2 at Lv4–6, +3 at Lv7–9)
Attack vs non-boss enemies +5%/Lv. Kill & BONUS MILE +10%/Lv
Attack rises with running speed. No effect at 100km/h or below. +4%/Lv at 150km/h; it keeps rising above that, but at 1/4 the rate
Enemy encounter rate +10%/Lv. In exchange, EXP gained +15%/Lv
Enemy encounter rate +10%/Lv. Kill & BONUS MILE also +3%/Lv
Move speed +5%/Lv. But enemy encounter rate also +10%/Lv
Kill & BONUS MILE +50%/Lv, boss MILE +50%/Lv, EXP gained +20%/Lv
Holding 115km/h or more for a while triggers OVERDRIVE (attack +3%/Lv, attack speed +2%/Lv). Ends after 0.8s below 107km/h. Move speed always +2%/Lv
Drain and SECOND WIND heal more (+1 heart at Lv4–6, +2 at Lv7–9). Overflow at full HP becomes 1 Shield (up to max +1)
Mob HP +15%/Lv, action speed +5%/Lv, encounter rate +12%/Lv, elite rate +2%/Lv, boss HP +10%/Lv. In exchange, kill & BONUS MILE +60%/Lv, boss MILE +60%/Lv
Distance EXP +20%/Lv. Doesn't apply to kill EXP
Blocking a hit with a Shield grants brief invincibility (0.4s +0.1s/Lv). This card alone also lets you hold 1 Shield
When you go down (falls included), revive with 2s of invincibility (HP 1–5 hearts by Lv). After reviving, this card is removed and can be offered again (retaken from Lv1)
Melee hits also damage enemies behind the target. Power and number of targets rise with Lv. Projectile pierce also up (+1 at Lv1–3, +2 at Lv4–6, +3 at Lv7–9)
Chance to heal 1 heart on enemy kill +3%/Lv. Hitting bosses also has a low chance to drain HP
When hit with HP at 30% of max or less, heal 1–3 hearts (2 at Lv5, 3 at Lv9). Needs a certain run distance to trigger again (10,000m at Lv1, 6,000m at Lv9)
A Shield that blocks 1 hit. Max 1 at Lv1–3, 2 at Lv4–6, 3 at Lv7–9. Used ones come back one at a time over time (faster with Lv)
Air attack +4%/Lv. Hitting in midair restores 1 used air jump (before landing: up to 1 time at Lv1–3, 2 at Lv4–6, 3 at Lv7–9)
Jump power +2%/Lv, air attack +3%/Lv
Front/back attacks fire a piercing slash forward. The faster you run, the farther, bigger and stronger the slash
Move speed -4%/Lv. A special card for when you want to run slower
EXP gained +40%/Lv. Max HP also up (+1 heart at Lv1–2, then +1 every 2 Lv; +5 at Lv9)
Hits have a low chance to call down lightning. Lightning power +4%/Lv; chains to +1 enemy at Lv1–3, +2 at Lv4–6, +3 at Lv7–9. Lightning also damages the area around it
Hits call down lightning. Lv1: 5% chance, base power 7.5; each Lv after: chance +2%, base power +1.5. Lightning hits the same enemy at most once per 0.4s
Wind blade hits spawn a tornado that deals continuous damage to nearby enemies (power and area rise with Lv). This card alone also has a low chance to release a wind blade on hit
Mob HP +15%/Lv. In exchange, kill & BONUS MILE +15%/Lv, kill EXP +5%/Lv
Treasure/reward MILE +30%/Lv (BONUS ZONE treasure and CLEAR/PERFECT, WANTED bounties). Boss MILE +10%/Lv, distance MILE +5%/Lv
Attack +3%/Lv, move speed +2%/Lv. Max HP also up (+1 heart at Lv1–2, then +1 every 2 Lv; +5 at Lv9)
A bounty target appears every so often (stronger and more frequent with Lv). Defeat it for bounty MILE; leave it behind and you get nothing. Kill & BONUS MILE +35%/Lv
Hits have a chance to fire a piercing wind blade forward. Lv1: 10% chance, power 8; each Lv after: chance +3%, power +1.5. Attack range also slightly up (+1%/Lv)
